handle.name: Loop handle and handle frame
handle.desc: Adjustable telescoping loop handle on two side tubes. Check the pivot joints move freely each day. There are no grease fittings anywhere on the Flex 2120: do not add grease steps to the service sheet.

console.name: Control panel, levers and traction bail
console.desc: Engine and reel controls on the panel, traction bail under the loop handle and a thumbwheel traction speed control. Check the traction and brake interlock switches and the parking brake every day before mowing.

engine.name: Engine: Subaru 126 cc OHC petrol
engine.desc: Single-cylinder air-cooled OHC with gear reduction (Toro engine assembly 133-8843). Clean the cooling fins and blower housing regularly. Never tip the machine more than 25 deg (oil runs into the cylinder and fuel out of the cap): use the stops on the TransPro 80 trailer. Subaru replacement engines are discontinued: Toro bulletin GR 04-10 replaces them with Honda kit 139-5637, so budget for it across the six units.

oil.name: Engine oil
oil.desc: 0.6 L, API SE or higher: SAE 30 in warm weather, 10W-30 for general use, 5W-30 in the cold. First change at 20 h, then every 50 h (sooner in dust). Drain warm, tipping back no more than 25 deg; drain plug 20-23 N.m. Check the level daily with the engine level and cool and the dipstick resting in, not screwed down.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner (foam + paper)
aircleaner.desc: Every 50 h wash the foam in soapy water, dry, re-oil and squeeze out; tap the paper element clean (no compressed air). Replace the paper element every 100 h. Element set 121-0618; kit 30097 is listed for walk Greensmasters 2012+ but its contents are not confirmed.

sparkplug.name: Spark plug
sparkplug.desc: NGK BR6HS. Check every 100 h: gap 0.6-0.7 mm, 23 N.m. Replace if cracked or fouled; do not sandblast or wire-brush it. Pull the lead off before working on the reel.

muffler.name: Muffler and heat shield
muffler.desc: Position shown is approximate. Keep clippings and oil off the muffler and shield: it runs hot. No part number in the bible: quote the engine serial to the dealer.

fueltank.name: Fuel tank and cap
fueltank.desc: About 3.0 L (the service manual says 2.7 L) of unleaded 91 RON, max E10. Clean the tank screen at 20 h, then every 100 h or monthly, whichever comes first: lift it out under the cap and wash it in clean fuel. Replace the fuel line every 1,000 h. For storage over 30 days add stabiliser, run 5 min, then run dry; do not keep stabilised fuel more than 90 days.

fuelfilter.name: In-line fuel filter
fuelfilter.desc: Listed in the engine assembly. Toro gives no change interval (the schedule cleans the tank screen instead): replace it if fuel flow is restricted.

clutch.name: Reel clutch (wet multi-disc) and housing
clutch.desc: Runs in 296 ml of Mobil ATF D/M (Toro 505-136; Toro Premium ATF 108-1186 pail). Change every 500 h: #2 is at about 767 h, so check the record for the 500 h change. At 1,000 h check the teeth fully disengage and do not bottom out, and the reel stops in under 7 s with the bedknife backed off. Grinding when the reels engage (job MCH-12) points to the clutch pack or seals.

mainbelt.name: Main drive belt
mainbelt.desc: Poly-V belt from the engine with a spring idler: it self-tensions, so there is no routine adjustment. Inspect at 1,000 h with the transmission bearings.

drumdrive.name: Traction drum drive and belt cover
drumdrive.desc: Drum drive belt (spring idler, self-tensioning) under the side cover. Check the belts and transmission bearings every 1,000 h. Keep water off the shift plate when cleaning: mild detergent, low pressure, never a pressure washer.

wheels.name: Transport wheels (drum axle stub)
wheels.desc: Transport wheels fit on the drum axle stubs to move between greens (wheels are off in this photo, shown by the stub). No wheel part number or tyre pressure in the bible: read the sidewall and quote the traction-unit serial to the dealer.

frame.name: Frame and cutting unit carrier
frame.desc: Tubular frame carrying the engine, drum and the flexing cutting unit. Check fasteners and pivot joints; tighten and touch up paint before storage. No grease points.

basket.name: Grass basket
basket.desc: Empty it before it overfills: a full basket throws clippings and loads the reel. Check the hanger lips for cracks.

reelbelt.name: Reel drive belt and cover
reelbelt.desc: Belt 99-2022 sits under the belt cover on the side of the cutting unit. Inspect it and the spring/bearing housing tension at 1,000 h. The reel-drive pulley under this cover has six clip settings: match clip to height of cut.

groomer.name: Universal groomer (only if fitted)
groomer.desc: Gearbox oil 50 ml 80W-90: first at 100 h, then every 500 h or yearly. Bulletin GR 14-50: the knob O-ring can perish in the sun on groomer drives 04648 s/n 318000001-319999999 (knob kit 137-0959).

cu1.name: Cutting unit (21 in, 11-blade EdgeSeries)
cu1.desc: Model 04290 cutting unit, 533 mm. Bench HOC 1.6-12.7 mm (High HOC kit 7-25 mm). Check reel-to-bedknife contact daily (light, paper cuts); 1 click = 0.018 mm. Reel and roller bearings are sealed: check for play, do not grease. Grind at the club 75 h interval or when the land passes 3 mm. HOC: the fleet list has #2 at 5 mm but the Oct 2026 note says 2.4 mm. Read the gauge first: Microcut knives cover 1.5-4.7 mm, above 4.7 mm fit a Tournament knife.

reel.name: Reel (21 in, 11 blades, low drag)
reel.desc: Backlap when dull, then file the burr off the bedknife front edge. Grind when the land is over 3 mm: 30 deg relief (+/-5), land 0.8-1.2 mm. New diameter 128.5 mm, service limit 114.3 mm; max taper 0.25 mm. Bearings sealed (2 per reel, flocked seals 115-3299).

bedknife.name: Bedknife and bedbar
bedknife.desc: Factory knife is EdgeMax Microcut 115-1880 (1.5-4.7 mm). Above 4.7 mm fit a Tournament knife (93-4263, club paid $76.47 from Amacron). 13 new screws 119-4151 at every change: outer pair to 1 N.m, then 25.4 N.m from the centre out. Bedbar bolts 27-36 N.m. Grind the knife after fitting.

froller.name: Front roller
froller.desc: Sealed bearings: check for play, no grease. Rebuild with the roller seal kit. Front brush 115-7377 fits the narrow Wiehle roller.

rroller.name: Rear roller (full, aluminium)
rroller.desc: Sealed bearings. Rebuild with the roller seal kit or replace the full roller.

cuframe.name: Cutting unit frame and DPA adjusters
cuframe.desc: Dual precision adjustment at each end sets reel-to-bedknife contact; rebuild with the DPA MVP kit when the adjusters get sloppy.

belt.name: Reel drive belt
belt.desc: Under the belt cover on the side of the unit. Inspect at 1,000 h.

133-8843.name: Engine assembly, Subaru 126 cc (Toro number)
133-8843.note: Subaru replacement engines are discontinued (bulletin GR 04-10): order Honda kit 139-5637 instead.

121-6392.name: Engine oil Toro Premium 10W-30 (55 gal drum)
121-6392.note: 121-6393 is the 5 gal pail. Any API SE+ oil is fine.

108-1186.name: Toro Premium ATF (pail)
108-1186.note: Alternative to Mobil ATF D/M 505-136 for the reel clutch (drum is 108-1185).

132-5484.name: Reel clutch pack kit
132-5484.note: For clutch faults such as grinding when the reels engage.

115-6744.name: Drum drive belt
115-6744.note: Check at 1,000 h. Spring idler, self-tensioning.

04290.name: Cutting unit, 21 in 11-blade EdgeSeries (model 04290)
04290.note: The serial on file 04290-403180054 is a cutting-unit serial: record the traction-unit plate (model 04044) for this machine.

108-4303.name: Bedknife Microcut Extended, 1.5-4.7 mm (7 deg top)
108-4303.note: Less aggressive; same HOC range as Microcut.

93-4264.name: Bedknife Low-cut
93-4264.note: In the catalog accessory list; not in the operator manual chart.

115-3299.name: Reel bearing seal, flocked (x2 per reel)

115-7377.name: Front brush for narrow Wiehle roller
115-7377.note: Accessory. Combs and scrapers are separate numbers: check the parts book.

137-0959.name: Groomer knob kit
137-0959.note: Bulletin GR 14-50, groomer drives 04648 s/n 318000001-319999999 only.

30097: MVP filter and spark plug kit (walk greensmasters 2012+)
121-6393: Toro dealer (any API SE+ oil OK)
115-6743: Main drive belt / drum drive belt
133-8898: Clutch seal MVP kit / clutch pack kit / clutch service assy
107-1594: Roller seal rebuild kit / rear full roller (aluminium)

model.note: Part outlines on the photo are drawn by hand and approximate; the air cleaner, spark plug, fuel filter and main belt are in the parts list. The photo shows the machine without transport wheels. Part numbers come from parts book 3418-411 (traction unit 04044), cutting-unit book 3414-469 (04290) and the operator manuals. The serial on file for one unit (04290-403180054) is a cutting-unit serial: read the traction-unit plate (04044) before ordering engine parts.
